sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "injury_accident"."game_id" AS e, "game"."Away_team" AS g, COUNT(*) AS m1 FROM "injury_accident" JOIN "game" ON "game"."id" = "injury_accident"."game_id"  GROUP BY "injury_accident"."game_id", "game"."Away_team"), "s2" AS (SELECT SUM("s1"."m1") AS v FROM "s1"), "s3" AS (SELECT "s1"."e" AS e, "s1"."g" AS g, "s1"."m1" AS m1, (CAST("s1"."m1" AS REAL) / "s2"."v") AS m2 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s2"."v" IS NOT NULL), "s4" AS (SELECT "s3"."e" AS e, "s3"."g" AS g, "s3"."m1" AS m1, "s3"."m2" AS m2, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY "s3"."g" ORDER BY "s3"."m1" DESC) AS r FROM "s3") SELECT "s4"."e" AS e, "s4"."g" AS g, "s4"."m1" AS m1, "s4"."m2" AS m2, "s4"."r" AS r FROM "s4" WHERE "s4"."r" <= 3
why: share of the all total of number of injury_accident records (all level)
rank within the group by number of injury_accident records, keep the top 3
